summary: Found six root causes in the CI logs (settings shared-state, UTC business date timezone bug, month-end review clamp, hash-order bin tie, rate-cache key, shared export spool file) and fixed them in stockroom/, plus a few hardening fixes (exact billable weight, review_day validation, transfer qty check, strict date parsing). The suite passed on 60 randomized runs of tools/ci.py across timezones, hash seeds and month-end dates, plus sorted and reverse order. Failures from cancelled runs (KeyboardInterrupt in test_reprice_catalog) and from the 2.6.0 unit conversion bug fixed in 2.6.1 are not filed.
